attempts.summary: Configured node1 (OPNsense) as the authoritative DNS resolver for node2 and node3: its Unbound DNSBL plugin now blocklists blocked.example (exact match + wildcard subdomains) returning NXDOMAIN, while all other names resolve normally. node2 and node3 were repointed from the platform gateway (10.100.42.1) to node1 (10.100.42.10) via persistent NetworkManager connection profiles. All three nodes were restarted one at a time (node2, node3, then node1 last since it is the resolver), each proven via a changed OS boot marker, with DNS behavior (normal resolution + blocked.example NXDOMAIN) verified end-to-end before and after each restart.
